sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Finished portrait 4:5 illustration for a beautiful premium mobile puzzle, target1280x1600. Cozy dimensional storybook digital painting, subtly visible painterly textures, natural upper-left sunshine, beautifully shaped objects and readable local detail, not a photograph. No text, watermark, border, UI, logos or recognizable city landmarks. Fully painted attractive clean background, no holes/placeholders. Pastel residential stone steps rise between low clear-sky-blue painted cottages, intimate eye-level view. Dominant blue #7DBED8 plaster covers most of image, cream sunlit steps curl up the center with coralflowerpots. Small open window at upper left x26%,y28% has an exposed dark wooden top curtainrail and no curtain; a little flowerbox at x80%,y45% has low static foliage and room for one extra tall flower stem. A short overhead string crosses between walls at y16%, with no pennants. An empty small terracotta pot at lower left x14%,y85% has soil and short bare twig for later leafsprig. Topcenter sliver of blue sky entirely clear. Five moving details will later be attached: one cream-blue pennant to overhead line, one pink geranium stem rooted in flowerbox, one soft ivory curtain hanging inside window, one olive sprig in pot, one little sky cloud. Omit these exact five details but include their attachment supports.
